title: Courier connection response for get courier connections
description: Courier connection response for getting courier connections

total.description: The total number of courier connections.

next_cursor.description: A string representing the cursor value for the next page of results.

has_next_page.description: To indicate if next page is available.

Courier_connection.title: courier_connection
Courier_connection.description: This model represents user-created courier connection details. AfterShip will use this information to retrieve tracking updates from carriers based on the provided tracking numbers.

id.description: The courier connection ID is a special set of numbers generated by AfterShip to define each user-created connection.

courier_slug.description: Unique courier code. Get courier codes [here](https://www.aftership.com/docs/tracking/others/supported-couriers).

credentials.description: It refers to the authentication details required for each specific carrier details required for each specific carrier (such as API keys, username, password, etc.) that the user must provide to establish a carrier connection. The content varies by carrier.

created_at.description: The date and time the courier connection was created. It uses the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ for the timezone GMT +0.

updated_at.description: The date and time the courier connection was updated. It uses the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ for the timezone GMT +0.

message.description: error message, only exist if the response status is not 2xx

type.description: error type, only exist if the response status is not 2xx
